The '''Tuulabi''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuulab]]. Originally a colony of 721 Humans led to the planet by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ingas Lek]], the population rose to around 6,000 during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Tuulabi preferred to live a rural existence without interference from galactic politics or the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Tuulabi did not form a government, or ally themselves with either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
